title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft Campus Solutions → Enrollment
description: Maps Oracle PeopleSoft Campus Solutions enrollment tables to the HELIX Enrollment resource.

source_tables.description: Student enrollment. One row per student per class per term.
Class schedule. Section details, capacity, schedule.
Term definition. Start/end dates, census dates.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + EMPLID + STRM + CLASS_NBR
Resolve to HELIX Student.helix_id via EMPLID lookup
Resolve to HELIX CourseSection.helix_id via CLASS_NBR + term lookup
Resolve to HELIX AcademicPeriod.helix_id via STRM lookup
Map PeopleSoft status codes: 'E'→'enrolled', 'W'→'waitlisted', 'D'→'dropped'. If CRSE_GRADE_OFF is populated and status='E' → 'completed'. 'V'→'auditing'.
attribute_mappings.notes: PeopleSoft enrollment status is simpler than Banner. Dropped vs. withdrawn may require checking ENRL_STATUS_REASON or ENRL_DROP_DT against institutional deadlines.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Cast to ISO 8601 date. Null if not dropped.
Direct map. Zero or null if course not yet completed.
Direct map. Official grade. Null if in progress.
Map PeopleSoft grading basis: 'GRD'→'standard', 'PNP'→'pass_fail', 'AUD'→'audit', 'SUS'→'satisfactory_unsatisfactory'. Codes in GRADING_BASIS table.
